facts.value: A small free church built on the teachings of Kaspar Schwenkfeld. His followers formed a distinct group in Silesia, and some who fled to Pennsylvania formed a community in 1734.

citations.excerpt: The Schwenkfelder Church in America, a small free church built around the teachings of German mystic Caspar Schwenkfeld, emerged at the time of the Protestant Reformation.
In Silesia they formed a distinct sect, which has lasted until the present time.
Those who had fled to Philadelphia in Pennsylvania (1734) formed a small community under the name of Schwenkfelders

facts.value_before_verify: A small free church built on the teachings of Kaspar Schwenkfeld. His followers formed a distinct group in Silesia, and some emigrated to Pennsylvania in 1734.
